tools.name: search_surf_spots
tools.description: Search published Portuguese surf spots in Swellwise by free-text query or region slug. Returns spot slugs, names, regions, coordinates, break types, beach orientation, and calibration status.

tools.name: get_spot_forecast
tools.description: Get compact marine, wind, and surf quality forecast for a published surf spot slug. Defaults to 3 days at a 3-hour step (max 8 days at 3-hour step, or max 3 days at 1-hour step). Always includes offshore modelling disclaimer and calibration status.

tools.name: get_spot_tides
tools.description: Get astronomical tide predictions on Zero Hidrográfico (ZH) for a published surf spot slug. Returns 30-minute heights and high/low extremes with datum, limitations, and FES2022 attribution.
